Necromancy is the dark art of death magic. At the lower levels, there is an assortment of rather nefarious abilities. Soon though, the ability of Cannibalism is gained, a skill which has inspired wide-spread fear of those practicing Necromancy. Through cannibalism, a Necromancer increases his life essence, which powers the higher abilities. At the very highest level, a Necromancer gains the power to protect his very soul from death.

The ability to regain the [[life essence]] necessary to use Necromancy may be sealed from individuals by the [[Dread Ecclesiarch of Transvital Corruption]], should they prove themselves to be directly against the ideals of the [[Lords of Evil]]. One who has undergone this process is said to be in [[anathema (severance)|anathema]].

The skill of '''Necromancy''' is available to members of the [[Apostate]] [[class]], along with [[Evileye]] and [[Apostasy]]. Once practised by the [[Occultist]] and [[Infernal]] classes as well.

 |target=

 |detail=This is truly the joy of the Necromancer. If there is a corpse on the ground that has not already been victimised by a fellow Necromancer, you may DRAW HEART. Then, in an orgy of gastronomic pleasure, you may CONSUME HEART. The greater the experience of the adventurer who provided the heart, the greater your gain in life essence will be. Enjoy this pleasure, my murderous friend, for there are few greater in life or death.<p>It is important to note that how much life essence you get is modified by the experience of your victim.</p>
}}

 |detail=Unleash your necromantic essence in a deadly soulstorm, cruelly assaulting the soul of your foe. This ability will attempt to force a metamorphosized adventurer back into his mortal form.<p>Against denizens, you will instead profane their soul with malign energy, causing them to take ten percent more damage from necromantic abilities(*), the curses of evileye(**), and the weaponmastery attacks of your fellow Infernals(***). In this case, the equilibrium and essence costs of this dark art shall be greatly reduced.<p>* NECROMANCY DECAY and TAINT.<br>** EVILEYE BLEED.<br>*** All weapon-based attacks in the WEAPONMASTERY skill when performed by an Infernal.</br>

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Exterminate
 |description=Destroy all plant life in a location.
 |lessons=1048
 |syntax=EXTERMINATE
 |required=5% life essence and 1000 mana
 |target=Room
 |cooldown=6.00 seconds of equilibrium and 12.00 upon completion
 |detail=Using your command of the energies of death, you are able to wipe a forest area clean of plant life, replenishing some of your essence. Be warned though, there is an essence cost to this ability, and unless there is a sufficient amount of plant life in the room, you may lose essence using it. It should also be noted that an exterminated room is no longer considered a forest room, so many Druidic abilities will not work in such a room.<p>Take note: prolonged use of extermination will take a toll on your essence reserves, and you will find that each subsequent attempt incurs a greater cost in essence than the last to perform.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Soulspear
 |description=Meld soul-matter from the dead into a physical weapon.
 |lessons=1289
 |syntax=EVOKE SOULSPEAR FROM <target corpse><br>THROW SOULSPEAR AT <target> <direction>
 |required=2.50% life essence
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=6.00 seconds of balance
 |detail=Soulspear allows the skilled Necromancer to form a weapon forged in the soul of the dead. By taking an adventurer corpse, you can form the soulspear. A corpse from an adventurer level 30 and under has too weak a soul to form such a powerful weapon out of. Beyond that, the higher the level of the victim, the more powerful the soulspear.<p>Once you have it, you may throw it at someone who is outside your room, anywhere in your line-of-sight. It will shatter shields and prismatic barriers, or, if the person lacks one of those, the necromantic energy will be released, summoning forth hands of the grave in your victim's location.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Transverse
 |description=Cross vast distances in a single step.

 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=3.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=This ability allows for swift travel across the land. You must initiate the activation from a room where hands of the grave have been summoned forth.<p>If your target also stands in a room where the hands grasp at the living, this travel is instantaneous. If the hands are not present, the target is required to be a practitioner of necromancy, and the travel will be delayed.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Blackwind
 |description=Assume the form of the deadly blackwind.
 |lessons=1427
 |syntax=BLACKWIND<br>HUMAN<br>CHOKE <target><br>SURGE <direction>
 |required=5% life essence, 500 mana and willpower drain
 |target=Adventurers
 |cooldown=4.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=This allows you to take the form of the deadly blackwind. While in this form, your freedom is severely limited, but your ability to be harmed is also severely restricted. After you have become the blackwind, you have the nefarious ability to slip down a victim's throat and CHOKE him. While in blackwind form, you will lose willpower very quickly as you strain to hold your nebulous form together. HUMAN is the command to return to your normal form.<p>In addition, you may SURGE in a direction to bypass closed doors, though this is a channeled action and will not bypass doors that are locked.</p>
}}

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Vivisect
 |description=Rip your victim's chest open and torture him to death.

Once your victim is splayed out and helpless, meaning all four of his or her limbs are withered, you may perform your experiments, killing your victim in horrifying agony.<p>Successful completion of this ability will thwart the ressurective capability of the starburst tattoo.</p>

{{Skill_detail
 |skill=Soulcage
 |description=Harness your life essence to escape death itself.
 |lessons=1736
 |syntax=SOULCAGE ACTIVATE<br>SOULCAGE DEACTIVATE<br>SOULCAGE STATUS
 |required=New soulcage (30% life essence), Reactivate (3%), Deactivate (2%)
 |target=
 |cooldown=12.00 seconds of equilibrium
 |detail=This is perhaps the greatest of the necromantic abilities, and carries with it the greatest life essence cost. It allows you to spin a web of life essence around your very soul, protecting it from death. Soulcage may only be used once every 6 Achaean days.<p>The soulcage can be deactivated by raising a barrier of life essence between it and your soul, preventing it from saving you from death. It may be reactivated later for a much lower essence cost.</p><p>SOULCAGE STATUS will show the current state of your soulcage, if any.</p>
}}
